thread:
oncall-bot: :rotating_light: Paging alert: 3x crashloop backoffs detected for runtime-pool/gpu-14 on node-gpu-07 (container: redwood-runtime). OOM/SEGV pattern detected in last 2 restarts. Priority: P1.

alex (oncall): seeing the same. Crashloop started ~2m ago. Affected pods are pinned to node-gpu-07 and node-gpu-08.

julia (runtime): grabbing logs now. early signs point to a null pointer in the ONNX kernel path inside the custom fused op. stacktrace snippet: `terminate called after throwing an instance of 'std::runtime_error'\n  what(): ONNXRuntime::Kernel::execute() -> nullptr deref`

rahul (sre): can we confirm this is a recent rollout? any new images or kernel modules?

julia (runtime): we rolled runtime:v2.14.3 ~1h ago with a fused-kernel optimization. rollback candidate is v2.14.2.

marta (eng-runtime): that fused kernel touches nvlink buffer management and a new cgroup memory accounting flag. Could be racing with CUDA memory allocator on node flaps.

opsbot: Incident command created: INC-2026-0315-2243. Bridge: https://meet.company/INC-2026-0315-2243. Runbook: /runbooks/runtime-crashloop.

alex (oncall): initial mitigation checklist: 1) cordon node-gpu-07, 2) drain affected pods to other healthy nodes, 3) scale down runtime ReplicaSet to reduce noise, 4) rollback to v2.14.2 if crash persists.

rahul (sre): doing cordon + drain now on node-gpu-07. command: ```kubectl cordon node-gpu-07 && kubectl drain node-gpu-07 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-emptydir-data --force```

ops-oncall: note: node-gpu-08 shows network flapping recently (kernel dmesg: NVLINK: link reset). Might be a hardware ripple causing allocator to hit a corner-case.

julia (runtime): copying full pod log for one of the crashed instances: ```2026-03-15T22:43:04Z [runtime] loading model ok
2026-03-15T22:43:05Z [runtime] allocating kv-cache size=1.2G
2026-03-15T22:43:06Z [runtime] cudaMemcpyAsync failed: unknown error (700)
2026-03-15T22:43:06Z [runtime] segfault at 0x0 in onnx_fused_kernel.cpp:214
```

marta (eng-runtime): action: disable fused-kernel via env override to validate. Set RUNTIME_DISABLE_FUSED_KERNEL=1 in the deployment config and rollout a patch. This avoids the new code path.

alex (oncall): patching deployment with a one-line kubectl set env: ```kubectl set env deployment/redwood-runtime RUNTIME_DISABLE_FUSED_KERNEL=1 --namespace=prod```. Applying canary on 1 pod first.

opsbot: Deploy started by alex (oncall). deploy-bot: rollout status is being monitored.

customer-ops: FYI: we have an enterprise Dedicated customer (acct: ACCT-998) who reported elevated tail latency on 2 endpoints ~5m ago. Possible correlation but not confirmed. No data plane token loss reported.

rahul (sre): after cordon/drain, some pods moved to node-gpu-09 and are stable so far. Crashbacks reduced from 3/min to 0.5/min.

julia (runtime): the canary pod with fused kernel disabled is healthy after 45s. Logs show no cudaMemcpyAsync errors.

marta (eng-runtime): this strongly implicates the fused path. Plan: keep fused disabled cluster-wide for now, collect heap/dump from affected node for postmortem, and prepare a hotfix that adds null guards and NVLINK probe resiliency.

alex (oncall): customer impact: partial for Dedicated pool for ~3 minutes for some clients, automatic fallback succeeded. No hosted API customer errors surfaced in SLOs yet. Notifying CS.

customer-ops: sent note to ACCT-998: "we're investigating elevated latency, mitigation in progress, will follow up with postmortem."

ops-oncall: leaving node-gpu-07 cordoned until hardware team can check NVLINK logs. Marked for deeper kernel/drivers triage.

rahul (sre): opened ticket HW-2026-211 against infra to run `nvidia-smi -q` and nvlink diagnostics on the node once it's available.

julia (runtime): creating an internal bug: RUNTIME-4521 - fused kernel null-deref on nvlink error. I'll attach logs and the temporary rollback steps.

marta (eng-runtime): postmortem checklist: timeline, blame/no-blame analysis, regression test for NVLINK flaps, canary gating for fused kernels, CI test to exercise cgroup + nvlink races.

alex (oncall): current status: mitigation applied (fused disabled), affected nodes cordoned, rollback staged, customer notified. Escalate to oncall lead if we see more than 2 crash clusters or ACCT-998 reports errors after 30m.

opsbot: Incident status changed to: mitigated -> monitoring. Incident owner: alex (oncall).

rahul (sre): followups: collect core dumps from the drained pods (if present), snapshot /var/log/nvidia, and preserve node image.

julia (runtime): will push hotfix branch with null checks and additional NVLINK retries. ETA 4h for patch + tests.

alex (oncall): thanks all. I'll close the bridge in 15m if no regressions. :thumbsup:

opsbot: Incident INC-2026-0315-2243 will transition to postmortem in 24h.
